component_rules: Keep command orchestration, reducer ownership, transport calls, preview resolution, and build cancellation in WorkbenchApp.
Move the existing Word template selector presentation into ProductBar through existing IDs and callbacks without duplicating state.
Keep WorkbenchShell responsible only for semantic layout composition, resizers, and mobile panel routing.
Reuse OutlinePanel, MarkdownEditor, DualPreviewPanel, DiagnosticsPanel, OutputFeedback, PanelHeader, diagnosticSummary, and presentDiagnostics.
Do not extract a second shell, state machine, transport hook, preview resolver, or design-system layer for this single screen.
Extract a visual group only if the same command or status presentation becomes duplicated in another production screen.
